svg.title: Training rig - parts catalogue view (issue 2, with Modification M01 parts)
svg.desc: Exploded view of the fictional training rig for the parts list. Item numbers: 1 fan assembly, 2 screws, 3 washers, 4 latches, 5 latch brackets, 6 filter housing, 7 filter element, 8 clamp, 9 differential pressure indicator, 10 control box, 11 connector, 12 access panel.
svg.text: Item 12: transparent panel (classroom variant) or metal panel (workshop variant).
